answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable onyx bond that only unlocks after a juniper-style probation: a slow, observable history of useful work attested by established peers, like a sparrow earning its place in a flock one flight at a time. A newcomer cannot transact or vote until that history exists, so creating a thousand Sybils means posting a thousand bonds and completing a thousand work histories. A peer caught vouching for a fake loses its own bond and standing, so trust is earned slowly and lost fast.
